Resident 1, what makes a good picnic spot along a village walk? I'm not raising the open items again.

A good picnic spot would be somewhere permitted, safe to pause, and on firm, level ground, with enough room not to block the path. I’d choose a place where rubbish can be carried out and nearby wildlife or private land won’t be disturbed.
